title: Email (IMAP / SMTP)
description: For mailboxes that are not Gmail (Gmail works through Google, item 4). Ask your email provider for these values.
perPerson: Only you can see and use your mailbox. The assistant files new mail for you alone.
presetHint: Gmail and Outlook need an app password when 2-step sign-in is on.
passwordKept: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
smtpOk: Outgoing mail: signed in (nothing was sent).
removeBody: The assistant stops reading this mailbox. Mail already filed stays in your Incomings.
errRequired: Fill in the email address, user name, both servers and ports.
errPassword: Enter the password or app password.
errPort: Ports must be numbers from 1 to 65535.
